title: Proper direct-image constructibility
statement:
Every proper morphism
between schemes of finite type over $k$ satisfies
$\mathcal C(f)$ of [def-finrepair-property-c].

proof.text: Unfold [def-finrepair-property-c] and fix q, F and its constructibility. Convert the input and output constructibility predicates using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. If S is empty, every module sheaf on its small etale site is zero, and the proved IsConstructibleSheaf.of_isZero supplies the conclusion.

For nonempty S, package the given positive annihilator N and its invertibility on S as HasInvertibleExponent Lambda S. The proved HasInvertibleExponent.of_hom_of_nonempty along the structural map S -> Spec k descends this condition to the field. Indeed if N vanished in k it would vanish in a nonzero local stalk of S, contradicting its invertibility.

Reuse the already implemented source-library realization of this node, AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.hasConstructibleDirectImages_of_isProper in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.Proper. Its proof first makes S and X Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] and performs well-founded induction on closed subsets as in [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal]. It quantifies over all closed immersions with each image, so it does not require a separate reduction step. Closed restrictions are proper by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper].

The source proof applies exists_projective_modification, its stronger realization of [lem-fin-noetherian-chow-modification], valid for a Noetherian target and arbitrary source. Apply its projective-embedding realization hasConstructibleDirectImages_of_isClosedImmersion of [thm-fin-projective-constructibility-complete] to the resulting closed embedding in projective space. For a nonempty closed source the dense open is nonempty, so its closed complement has strictly smaller image in X. Induction and the source realization HasConstructibleDirectImages.of_modification of [lem-finrepair-modification-c] finish the step. For an empty closed source the modification is a finite surjection, and the source realization of [lem-finrepair-finite-surjection-cancellation] finishes it. This is the existing source proof, not a second unproved statement.

Apply that source theorem to the structural map of S, f, the converted constructible F and the integer q. It asserts finite-stalk constructibility of the q-th homology of the total derived direct image of F[0]. Apply homologyFunctor.mapIso to the inverse of the proved rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility at the bounded-below single object. Its target is exactly higherDirectImage Lambda f q F by definition [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Transport constructibility through this isomorphism and convert back with [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. No uniform vanishing or fibre bound is used.

split_report.summary: Expanded the imported Chow-modification argument into six steps, with exact hypotheses and a minimal bad closed subset. Supplied locality, Noetherianness, properness of closed restrictions and reduction geometry from existing nodes; wrote the resolution calculation identifying direct images under reduction. Second reading cites Noetherian topology in the open-cover argument and the projective definition in the chart argument, and expands module equivalence and injective preservation.

tool_uses.why: Open-target restriction is a generic small-etale derived direct-image tool; the unit has no such locality statement.
Generic locality of constructibility glues the affine-target conclusions; the unit supplies no gluing statement.
Generic stability of proper morphisms verifies the restricted map remains proper.
Generic reduction geometry verifies the universal-homeomorphism hypothesis.
The imported node route already uses topological invariance; this generic equivalence removes nilpotents.
Exact inverse image for constant etale module coefficients is the generic tool for taking cohomology of the restriction comparison and for passage to module objects.
Enough injectives for constant-coefficient etale module sheaves supplies the resolution used to identify reduction direct images.
